testCreateDrop4.spec: SPARQL 1.1 Update section 3.2.2 (DROP SHOULD return failure if the named graph does not exist; stores that do not record empty graphs always return success)
testCreateDrop4.note: addGraph of an empty graph records no graph in the engine (leana's in-memory dataset keeps no empty graphs), the engine records empty graphs, so DROP GRAPH fails; Jena's dataset does not record empty graphs and DROP succeeds.
